title: Build big, ship small
summary: The cow image is over 1 GB because it ships the whole Go toolbox. Use a multi-stage build to ship only the program.

tasks.title: The `Dockerfile` has two stages, and the second copies from the first
tasks.hint: Name the first stage: `FROM golang:1.25 AS build`. After the build lines, start a second stage with `FROM scratch` and bring in only the program: `COPY --from=build /src/cow /cow`.

tasks.title: `small-cow` is built and the cow still talks
tasks.hint: `docker build -t small-cow .`, then `docker run --rm small-cow`. In the second stage the program is at `/cow`, so the last line is `ENTRYPOINT ["/cow"]`.

tasks.title: `small-cow` is smaller than 20 MB
tasks.hint: `docker images small-cow` shows the size. If it's still huge, the last `FROM` isn't `scratch` (or a small image like `alpine`).
